verdict.tagline: Tactical chess with frantic gunfights, clumsy but brilliantly fun.
for_you_if: you want fast matches with friends
not_for_you_if: you need stable frame rates on release hardware
you play primarily with random matchmaking

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the combat and FPS mechanics as clunky, uncoordinated, and poorly executed.

citations.review_text: cool idea.. but everything about the actual FPS aspect of this game is SO clunky i never have any clue what's going on. some things are too OP and other attacks do nothing. desperately needs polish and refining

Genuinely one of the worst FPS games I have ever played lmao. I know its obviously a joke game and the concept is really cool but ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ is the combat awful, the sensitivity is shaky and uncoordinated even if you change it to your preference. The abilities are totally worthless unless you're using a piece that just has a busted weapon or specific ability,  the projectiles has to have some of the worst coding ever. Like I said I know it is a joke game but with such a cool concept, why have such an awful execution, this literally feels like I'm playing some janky ass flash game like I'm back in school. Worth playing with a friend like once maybe.

This game, fundamentally lacks chess, as at the end of the day, it's just whoever can do better in this specific FPS, which itself, is not well made, as all the pieces feel abhorrently balanced, and extremely non-beginner friendly. The entire concept could be fun, if both aspects were more well balanced, in a chess boxing sort of way. but I cannot recommend this game, as it feels like a waste of time

citations.review_text: I love to play this game with my friend, and play public lobbies if theres any (if not i open a lobby). ive had friends on low end pcs play and it didnt run great but i have a semi decent pc so it runs great at the highest graphics. also the same friend i play with bought me the dlc and i love it. the dlc fixed alot of balancing issues i had with the game. i strongly reccommend if your atleast average at either chess or fps games.
this game is really fun but it doesnt have much players so you couldnt play with randoms

Old review: I'm glad I found a good free game I liked, but it's just too buggy to play with. The Tutorial AI doesn't fight you in FPS style, and for how many people actually host this game? The chances are low. Really. It's an awesome looking game, and if you want, get it! But I don't fully recommend this as a good game. Whether or not the twist they've given chess is funny! The game though, sometimes glitches after the first FPS fight. Then when I select to kill another pawn it just stops there. Me and the opponent are unable to interact with any of our characters (I think) and then the only thing I can do is leave.
When I also do a fight in the tutorial after the end of the fight it just resets all of it back.
New Revision: The game is actually fantastic! I should've just played more. That's all. I really love the strategizing, I love the abilities and attacks, I like alot of things. Sure! The things I mentioned up there still exist, well with the exception that the game just didn't properly send the message for when the host leaves. But with all that, it's still a revolutionary gem. Still the game is dead and almost everyone I play with ragequit, I hate that. Most of my friends hate it and I can see why, but I like the game for now.
